0.$description:
(Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) 
All boxShadow primitive groups include a 0 value to represent the intentional absence of a shadow. This lets components reference 'no shadow' the same way they reference any other shadow value, avoiding conditional logic.

50.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Defines a shadow rendering recipe composed of offset, blur, and opacity, using maximum blur and minimum opacity for the softest, most diffuse effect in the scale. Used to create visual depth and separation. Does not encode meaning, interaction state, or hierarchy—those are defined by semantic tokens. Shadow colors are derived from the neutral ink palette and composed using opacity tokens.

100.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Defines a shadow rendering recipe composed of offset, blur, and a fixed light color. Distinct from the shadow family, which composes ink-based colors to darken and recede; glow composes a fixed white to lighten and lift. Does not encode meaning, interaction state, or hierarchy—those are defined by semantic tokens.
